review_blocks.evidence: Abstract and introduction position the paper as protocol-aware evaluation with conservative deployment claims.
PDF text extraction shows auto-generated captions such as 'Figure 1: Figure 1...' and supplementary figures auto-numbered as Figure 5-7 while captions say Figure S1-S3.
Author Contributions remains '[To be completed according to the final author list.]'.
Automatic, GT-derived, GT-assisted, and supervised protocols are mixed in some result tables; protocol caveats are present but table emphasis can still be misread.
Stability perturbations, ECE definition, and runtime measurement details need fuller reproducibility description.
Data and Code Availability lists local result files and scripts but lacks formal dataset URLs/licenses, repository/supplement location, checkpoint handling, and included/excluded artifacts.
Core manuscript values match experiments/results/summary_stats_v2.csv after rounding.
experiments/prompt_generator.py implements nearest-foreground fallback; experiments/tests/test_prompt_generator.py includes concave-shape regression tests.
